import RNA

target = '(((((((((((((((.(((((.((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).))))).(((.....))).(((((.((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).))))).(((.....))).(((((.((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).))))).(((.....))).(((((.((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).))))).(((.....))).(((((.((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).))))).)))))))))))))))'
n = len(target)
stack=[]
pair=[-1]*n
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop()
        pair[j]=i
        pair[i]=j

seq = ['']*n

import random
random.seed(42)

# base assign: for unpaired, use A by default, but for loop nt use varied caps
for i in range(n):
    seq[i] = 'A'

# GC pair options to vary - use different pair patterns per stem depth to avoid self-similarity
gc_pairs = [('G','C'), ('C','G')]
au_pairs = [('A','U'), ('U','A')]

# assign pairs: outer big stems get GC, inner short stems (2bp) get GC too but vary
done = set()
for i in range(n):
    j = pair[i]
    if j > i and i not in done:
        done.add(i); done.add(j)

# Now assign per stem group with variety based on position to prevent identical repeats
stems_list = []
visited = set()
pairset = {i:pair[i] for i in range(n) if pair[i]>i}
for i,j in sorted(pairset.items()):
    if i in visited: continue
    stem=[(i,j)]
    visited.add(i)
    ii,jj=i,j
    while (ii+1) in pairset and pairset[ii+1]==jj-1:
        ii,jj=ii+1,jj-1
        stem.append((ii,jj))
        visited.add(ii)
    stems_list.append(stem)

print(len(stems_list), "stems")

# assign GC-rich pairs alternating to each stem, with per-stem-index variation seed
random.seed(1)
for sidx, stem in enumerate(stems_list):
    for k,(i,j) in enumerate(stem):
        # alternate G-C / C-G along the stem, offset by sidx to reduce identical repeats
        if (k+sidx) % 2 == 0:
            seq[i],seq[j] = 'G','C'
        else:
            seq[i],seq[j] = 'C','G'

# now hairpin loops: 5-nt loops closed by a 2bp stem "((.....))"
# find loops: unpaired stretches between a closing pair with length 5
for i,j in pairset.items():
    if j-i-1==5:
        # this is directly closing a 5nt loop only if positions i+1..j-1 all unpaired
        if all(pair[k]==-1 for k in range(i+1,j)):
            loopseq = list('GAAAC')
            for offset,pos in enumerate(range(i+1,j)):
                seq[pos] = loopseq[offset]

# linkers (unpaired outside loops) - keep as A, maybe fine

final = ''.join(seq)
print(len(final))
print(final)

res = RNA.fold(final)
print(res)
print(target)
print(res[0]==target)
